title: video: Add borderless fullscreen window mode
body:
## Summary
- Add a new `borderless` config option for borderless fullscreen (`SDL_WINDOW_FULLSCREEN_DESKTOP`)
- `fullscreen` remains a bool — fully backward compatible with existing configs
- In-game video menu gets a separate BORDERLESS ON/OFF toggle
- Borderless fullscreen allows easy Alt-Tab/Cmd-Tab without hijacking the display

## Config example
```
fullscreen=true
borderless=true
```

## Test plan
- [x] `fullscreen=false` — game runs windowed
- [x] `fullscreen=true, borderless=false` — exclusive fullscreen (existing behavior)
- [x] `fullscreen=true, borderless=true` — borderless fullscreen, can Alt-Tab away
- [x] Old configs with just `fullscreen=true` still work (borderless defaults to false)
- [x] Toggle both options via in-game VIDEO settings menu
